note: Single source of truth for the shell commands printed on /install and /getting-started. Both pages render their code blocks from this file, and site/scripts/check-commands.mjs executes every entry here. `network: true` marks a step that needs a download (the release archive, SHA256SUMS, the git checkout for `cargo install`, or the archive those steps produced); the gate skips it. `cleanup` names paths the gate removes after the run so the walkthrough does not litter the repository root.
